exam: 103年專門職業及技術人員高等考試會計師、不動產估價師、專利師、民間之公證人考試
subject: 英文

essays.text:
請將下列英文翻譯成中文
①An affidavit is a voluntary, sworn written statement.（10 分）
②A notary public is considered a “public official” and, as such, is held personally liablefor any fraud or negligence in the performing of the duties of the offices.（20 分）

請將下列中文翻譯成英文
①公證人必須積極地去證明要求公證之人的身分。（10 分）
②不論任何情況公證人都不可收取超過執行公證行為所需的規費。（20 分）
英文作文（40 分）Write an essay in 250 words in which you explain why a notary public must adhere tothe law when performing a notarization .
